newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to reply to Bre-X, Barrick soon -official.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to reply to Bre-X, Barrick soon -official.

text.p: Indonesia will reply this week or next to a joint submission made by Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp outlining their deal on the huge Busang gold find in East Kalimantan, an official from the Mines and Energy Ministry said on Wednesday.
"We hope to send the letter to Bre-X and Barrick this week or next week at the latest," the official, who declined to be identified, told Reuters.

Umar Said, the ministry's secretary-general, said on January 2 that he, Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana and government lawyers were studying a letter received last month from Bre-X and Barrick outlining the deal they had reached.

"Our reply will note that the Indonesian government can accept the agreement between them (Bre-X and Barrick) on the understanding that they wish to split 67.5 percent for Barrick, 22.5 percent for Bre-X and 10 percent for the Indonesian government," the official said.
He said the letter would also point out that Bre-X and Barrick had to settle with their Indonesian partners.
"We know that they have local partners, so this must be cleared by them (Bre-X and Barrick)," the official said.
"After they receive our letter, they will have one month to report back to the government," he said.
Bre-X estimates the Busang find contains at least 57 million ounces of gold worth over $21 billion at current prices.
